issue.title: Release builds fail
issue.body:
I build liked this:
```cd DroneCore
make clean
BUILD_TYPE=Release make
```
But when I run this  (or `BUILD_TYPE=Release make default`) I get lots of build errors like:
```/home/ubuntu/DroneCore/core/integration_test_helper.h: In member function 'virtual void SitlTest::SetUp()':
/home/ubuntu/DroneCore/core/integration_test_helper.h:12:38: error: ignoring return value of 'int system(const char*)', declared with attribute warn_unused_result [-Werror=unused-result]
         system("./start_px4_sitl.sh");
                                      ^
```

comments.body: I can't reproduce this with current master (a30010bee275b6996f5bbfe3b4dbb8ab0792236a), neither on Linux, nor on macOS.

I just rebuilt current master on ubuntu Linxux and had same problem. Does this [gist help](https://gist.github.com/hamishwillee/9b4a6a282b25eb2429424169bf39db54). If not, should I perhaps try a completely fresh ubuntu?

Thank you, that helps because I can see:

```
-- The C compiler identification is GNU 6.2.0
-- The CXX compiler identification is GNU 6.2.0
```

Ok, I could not see these warnings with GCC 7.2 in Fedora 26 but I can reproduce them in Ubuntu 16.04 in docker actually.

I'll add the release builds to CI and then fix it.
Awesome! I'm using that GCC because it is the toolchain used to build PX4 for NuttX.
